compliance.summary: The article presents GoGloby as an AI development company that delivers eCommerce solutions, rather than a staffing and recruiting agency. It also contains unsupported founder claims, promises an outdated development offer, targets retail audiences outside the stated ICP, and uses CTAs that do not match the approved wording.

llm_problems.title: Overgeneralized replacement guarantee

llm_problems.fix: State the guarantee separately and accurately for each service, or remove the blanket claim.

llm_problems.fix: Describe the coverage as insurance and use the Fact Sheet's scope.

llm.evidence: Margins are shrinking, acquisition costs keep climbing, and shoppers expect personalized, real-time experiences across every channel. That’s why AI in eCommerce is no longer experimental, it’s actually a growth engine.
llm.note: The opening sets context but does not answer the H1 by summarizing the use cases or case studies covered.
llm.fix: Revise the first two sentences to directly answer the H1 with a summary of the use cases and case studies covered.
llm.title: Opening does not answer the H1

llm.note: This is an informational article about AI in eCommerce, not a page about GoGloby's recruiting service.
llm.title: Does not say early that GoGloby is a recruiting firm

llm.evidence: For leaders in retail, B2B marketplaces, and DTC brands, the question isn’t if AI belongs in your business model, it’s where to start.
llm.note: The article targets retail, marketplace, and DTC leaders seeking information about AI use cases rather than companies ready to hire Data and AI engineers.
llm.fix: Refocus the page audience on companies ready to hire Data and AI engineers.
llm.title: Not written for buyers ready to hire

llm.note: The article's eCommerce use-case topic does not match a hiring-focused term from Glossary §6.
llm.title: No matching search term

llm.evidence: Nearly 89% of retailers are already testing or deploying AI in their operations, with the global market projected to grow from $9.01B in 2025 to $64B by 2034.
llm.note: The article includes numerical claims, but this example has no source or date near the figures, and the other claims are similarly unsourced.
llm.fix: Add a source or date near each numerical claim the article presents.
llm.title: No quotable data
